name: Anti-debugging techniques (ptrace, timing checks) in stripped ELF
topic: Anti-debugging techniques (ptrace, timing checks) in stripped ELF
description: Anti-debugging techniques (ptrace, timing checks) in stripped ELF -- a hard-tier reverse engineering challenge. Review the bundled artifacts, locate the encoded clue, decode it, and recover the flag. Flag format: pwn{...}
objectives: Inspect the challenge bundle for "Anti-debugging techniques (ptrace, timing checks) in stripped ELF"
Locate the encoded artifact (look in every shipped file)
Unwrap the encoding applied to the artifact
Recover the plaintext flag and submit it in pwn{...} format

hints.text: Start by inspecting every file in the bundle (hex dump, headers, magic bytes).
The artifact is wrapped in a non-text container -- use the right parser.
The artifact is a double layer: hex -> base64 -> XOR. Unwind both layers and recover the 4-byte XOR key.
